description: The lower Jinsha cascade scheduling deposit contains carbon-flux parameters for water surfaces and drawdown areas, carbon burial rates and greenhouse-gas warming factors. This resource is provided by Zuowen, Tan. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV, MD formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Hydrological and operational inputs are not redistributed because the authors lack redistribution rights; the repository is not the full scheduling dataset. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
